name: Discord Rich Presence
author: Hyrule
description: Broadcasts your live KIF adventure to Discord Rich Presence: full-size custom fusion sprites, stylized Kanto & Sevii location pixel art, gym badges, Pokédex, caught shinies, fusions, battle status, and Solo/Multiplayer session info with full in-game settings.

permission_notes.outside_files: Connects to the local Discord desktop client via Windows Named Pipe (discord-ipc).
permission_notes.game_files: Saves your Rich Presence configuration and logs inside the mod folder.
